Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL3039007. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3039007'. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name (pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
